summary: This bill amends existing law to allow the President to transfer Russian sovereign assets into the Ukraine Support Fund without confiscating them, enabling these funds to be invested in interest-bearing obligations and requiring quarterly disbursements of at least $250 million to Ukraine, while also mandating reports on Russian assets held in other countries and encouraging diplomatic efforts for those countries to repurpose such assets for Ukraine.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to facilitate the transfer of frozen Russian sovereign assets to a Ukraine Support Fund and mandate their quarterly obligation for assistance to Ukraine. This directly increases financial aid to Ukraine, which is a form of foreign aid.
